annotations.title: Create a cart link for the buyer

description: Create a lootcodes.com link that opens the buyer's cart review with exact variants and quantities (1 to 5 each, up to 10 items) chosen from get_product_options. The buyer sees each item, confirms, then pays on the site; this tool adds nothing to any cart, reserves no stock and creates no order. Items that are unavailable or need the product page (top-ups, custom amounts, several platforms) are returned in rejected.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for the unit prices shown in the answer (default USD).

productSlug.description: Product slug from a catalogue result.

language.description: Language for names and links (default en).

name: create_cart_link
